we have synthesized novel thermotropic LC copolymers, poly{trans-methoxyl-cinnamic acid (MCA)-co-trans-4-hydroxy-cinnamic acid}, from phenolic phytic monomers by a thermal acidosis-polycondensation.

the synthesis of novel LC biocopolymers with high molecular weight, high thermal stability and strong adhesion, from renewable phytomonomer resources, and the copolymeric LC biopolymer is expected to be a novel functional material for the development of high-performance green materials.

poly(MHCA:co-DHCA)s are a novel type of thermotropic LC biopolymer with high molecular weight, high Tg and T10, and strong adhesion to carbon substrate.
the present copolymers have a high potential to be used as a novel LC adhesive for the carbon fiber reinforced composites (CFRC) and other LC adhesives for LC materials.

the copolymersion of MHCA and DCDA is a promising candidate for a new thermotropic LC adhesive with high shear strength.
